text.p: Ingram Micro Co shares rallied after their New York Stock Exchange debut on Friday, climbing almost 22 percent, or 3-7/8, to 21-7/8 in midday trade.
Ingram is the world's largest distributor of computer hardware, software and networking equipment.
The 20 million shares priced at $18 each, in the middle of the $17 to $19 range that had been raised from $14 to $16 per share due to heavy demand, according to lead underwriter Morgan Stanley.
-- New Holland NV, a manufacturer of agricultural and heavy machinery owned by Fiat SpA, was off 1/4 to 21-1/4 in heavy trade that put it atop the NYSE's most-actives list.
With the 53.5 million-share offering, Fiat spins off about 30 percent of New Holland and retails the balance.
-- Delta Financial Corp jumped 4-1/2 per share to 21, also in vigorous NYSE trade.
The four million shares priced this morning at $16.50 each, at the top of the range.
NatWest Capital Markets was the lead underwriter.

-- Multicanal American Depositary Receipts gained 1-1/2 to 15-1/2 in busy Nasdaq trade. Morgan Stanley was the lead underwiter of the 11-million share offering, which priced at the top of the $12 to $14 per share range.
